```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Support for the repeal of \"Don't Ask Don't Tell\".",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for the implementation of policies to allow qualified men and women to serve openly regardless of sexual orientation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"More than 12,500 service men and women have been discharged on the basis of sexual orientation since the \"Don't Ask, Don't Tell\" policy was implemented.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The discharge of service members based on sexual orientation has cost over $360 million.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Many of those forced out had special skills in high demand, such as translators, engineers, and pilots.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The military is having a tough time recruiting and retaining troops.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"It is wrong to deny the country the service of brave, qualified people.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Taxpayer dollars should be spent to invest in fighting men and women, not to fatten the pockets of private companies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Defense and State Departments will develop a strategy for determining when contracting makes sense, and when certain functions are \"inherently governmental\" and should not be contracted out.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The legal status of contractor personnel will be established, making possible prosecution of any abuses committed by private military contractors.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A system of improved oversight and management will be created to restore honesty, openness, and efficiency to contracting and procurement.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
